text:
Jules (CS): quick roundup from today's onboarding wave. three repeating asks: a one-click CSV export of feature asks for product, a small 'which route used my tokens' badge in the Console, and a TTF (time-to-first-success) metric per account so AMs can spot stalled rollouts.
Clara (AM): two pilot customers said they'd pause their rollout if costs keep spiking unexpectedly. one renewal in ~25 days. marking this as potential churn trigger.
Katerina (PM): thanks. my proposal: ship CSV export + token-badge as short-term fixes, TTF metric as next sprint. we should surface quotes and renewal windows in each ticket.
Owen (SE): rough effort: CSV export backend + UI link ~1 dev day; token-badge (needs daily aggregation job + tiny UI) ~1 week; TTF metric (DB field + dashboard card) ~3-4d. we'll need telemetry: `route.token_usage.daily` and `onboarding.event.success_at`.
Jules (CS): sample quote: "We had no idea the QA route was burning tokens until the bill arrived. We might not renew if this continues."
Clara (AM): adding accounts to thread: HORIZON-14 (Enterprise, renew in 25d), MAPLE-3 (Mid, renew in 90d). HORIZON flagged high.
Katerina (PM): can CS attach severity (1-5) and a short impact note for each ask? it'll help triage.
Jules (CS): yes. format I'll use: account, tier, renewal_days, ask, quote, severity. will push 8 rows by EOD.
Owen (SE): one safety ask for TTF metric: we should avoid leaking PII, only surface anonymized success rates per account. also rate-limit badge queries to avoid extra cost.
triage-bot: created ticket CS-101224 "Feature-asks CSV export" and CS-101225 "Per-route token badge". linked CS-101226 "TTF metric per account". assigned CS-101224 -> @Katerina.
Katerina (PM): adding acceptance criteria: CSV header names + sample rows, badge tooltip explaining window (7d default), and TTF definition (first successful inference leading to configured SLO).
Jules (CS): will attach raw quotes + sample CSV. quick sample row: AcmeCorp,Enterprise,25,"CSV export","We had no clue which route spiked",5.
Clara (AM): I'll prioritize outreach for HORIZON-14 and request a remediation call template. if CS flags anything >=12 on the renewal-risk score, I'll join the call.
Owen (SE): noted. I'll scope telemetry changes and post exact estimates tomorrow.
Katerina (PM): thanks team. plan: ship CSV export in next sprint, push token-badge as an experiment behind a flag, and add TTF to roadmap. Jules, ping when the scored list is ready and I'll move tickets into triage board. :raised_hands:
